summary: beaver-ui-header ships an install/import-time binary dropper using obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts and DNS-TXT fallback
details: On module load, index.js require()s./_loader, which fetches a platform-specific binary from Cloudflare Workers hostnames assembled at runtime from split string fragments (e.g. oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, cf100-416/cf103-070/cf101-adf.workers.dev), with a base64-chunked DNS TXT fallback under *.dl.wel1.ru. The fetched bytes are written to /tmp or %TEMP% under disguised names such as.cache_<hex> and dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe, chmodded 0755, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd. Dangerous APIs are hidden through property-string concatenation (require("child_"+"process"), fs["chmod"+"Sync"]) and a cache-TTL stamp gates execution to fire once per host. The declared React UI component purpose has no relationship to fetching and executing remote binaries from anonymous edge-worker hosts, and no pinning, hash, or signature verification is performed on the downloaded payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
